thread.old_title: The ten virgins — oil in the vessel, the shut door, and I know you not (Ezekiel 36; Zechariah 4; Matthew 7)
thread.title: The ten virgins — oil in the vessel, the shut door, and I know you not (Ezekiel 36; Zechariah 4; Matthew 7)
thread.old_summary:
It ain't new. Ten virgins go out to meet the bridegroom, all with lamps, and the parable turns on one thing they did not all carry:

*They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:* (Matthew 25:3)

*But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.* (Matthew 25:4)

A lamp with no oil burns for a while on what it was lit with and then goes out. The prophets had already said what fills the vessel so the lamp keeps burning, and it is not the lamp:

*A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.* (Ezekiel 36:26)

*And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.* (Ezekiel 36:27)

*But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.* (Jeremiah 31:33)

The Spirit put within, and the Torah written in the heart so that a man walks in the statutes: that is oil in the vessel. Zechariah saw a lampstand that burned because oil was fed to it, and heard what the oil was:

*And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:* (Zechariah 4:2)

*Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* (Zechariah 4:6)

Then the door:

*And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.* (Matthew 25:10)

*Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open to us.* (Matthew 25:11)

*But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.* (Matthew 25:12)

Mark who is outside. Not strangers, not the tares, but virgins who went out to meet him, with lamps, calling him *Adonai (Lord)*. They are of the house, and the door is shut on them. He had said it before, and said what the shut door is about:

*Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 7:21)

*And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.* (Matthew 7:23)

Luke has the same knock and the same answer:

*When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:* (Luke 13:25)

Yahuah (the LORD) shut a door once before, on the whole earth, with the ones inside who had done as he commanded:

*And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as Elohim (God) had commanded him: and Yahuah (LORD) shut him in.* (Genesis 7:16)

The virgins outside had the lamp and the name and the right road, and no oil. The sifting at the door is of the house, the ones who called him *Adonai (Lord)* and did not walk in the statutes, and the warning is to the house:

*Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam cometh.* (Matthew 25:13)

cards.src_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
cards.tgt_text: Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
cards.old_note: *Lord, Lord ... I never knew you* — direct echo.
cards.note: Matthew 7:21 — *Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) The ten went out with lamps to meet the bridegroom, and here is who gets in. Not the ones who only say *Adonai (Lord)*, but the one who does the will of the Father. The virgins who come knocking later call him by that same title, and it does not open the door.
cards.prose: The ten went out with lamps to meet the bridegroom, and here is who gets in. Not the ones who only say *Adonai (Lord)*, but the one who does the will of the Father. The virgins who come knocking later call him by that same title, and it does not open the door.
cards.old_member_note: The *Lord, Lord* + *I never knew you* direct-echo.
cards.member_note: Matthew 7:21 — *but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* Entering the kingdom is for the one who does the Father's will, not for the one who only calls out the title.

cards.tgt_text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
cards.note: Leviticus 8:10 — *And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) Oil in the Torah is poured on what is set apart, the tabernacle *and all that was therein*. The oil goes into the vessels. The virgins went out with lamps, and the wise had the oil to go with them.

cards.tgt_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
cards.note: Matthew 22:1 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) Yahusha (Jesus) is still speaking in parables, and the next one is a wedding too. cards.src_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
cards.tgt_text: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
cards.note: Proverbs 1:7 — *The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) The ten are split into wise and foolish, and this verse draws the same line. The fool is the one who despises *wisdom and instruction*. The foolish virgins took lamps and no oil. The beginning of knowledge is the fear of Yahuah (LORD), and it shows in what a person carries.

cards.member_note: Proverbs 1:7 — *but fools despise wisdom and instruction.* The fool is the one who despises instruction, and the foolish virgins are the ones who went out with no oil.

cards.tgt_text: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
cards.note: Proverbs 9:1 — *Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) Wisdom builds a house and gets it ready, *hath hewn out* her pillars before anyone comes. The wise virgins prepared the same way, with oil in their vessels, and they were the ones who went in with the bridegroom.

cards.member_note: Proverbs 9:1 — *Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars.* Wisdom prepares ahead, as the wise virgins did when they took oil with their lamps.

cards.src_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
cards.tgt_text: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
cards.note: Proverbs 9:13 — *A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) The foolish woman is *clamorous* and *knoweth nothing*. The foolish virgins match her: lamps, a loud cry at the door, and nothing in the vessel. Being loud is not being wise. Having the lamp is not the same as knowing him.

cards.member_note: Proverbs 9:13 — *A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.* The foolish one is loud and knows nothing, like the virgins crying at the shut door.

cards.src_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
cards.tgt_text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
cards.old_note: *Come, buy wine and milk without money.*
cards.note: Isaiah 55:1 — *Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) What the vessel needs is offered to whoever thirsts and comes, without money. In the parable the foolish go off to buy only when the bridegroom is already on his way. What Isaiah calls everyone to take *without money and without price*, they went looking for too late.

cards.member_note: Isaiah 55:1 — *come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.* The call to come and take freely is the supply the foolish virgins went looking for too late.

cards.src_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
cards.tgt_text: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
cards.note: Revelation 19:7 — *Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.* *Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.* (Matthew 25:1) The bridegroom the virgins go out to meet is here the Lamb, and the marriage has come. His wife *hath made herself ready*, and that is what the parable asks. Those who were ready went in. Being ready is oil in the vessel, the law walked in.
